value.rationale: The same-model source establishes only LLN for occupations and an unrelated Doob-martingale FCLT. Empirical coordinate occupation is a natural observable of long-memory systems. The exact decomposition reveals a distinct waiting-time/selector Brownian noise term of magnitude k-1, changes the sharp variance to k/(3-4p)+k-1, and produces a full three-regime jointly independent limit across coordinates sharing one clock. This isolates how asynchronous observation modifies memory-driven fluctuations, not a routine parameter substitution or renaming.
